Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
rodrigo...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Hi! This question is disturbing the games I have been played. If I atack a
> untapped vampire (in a Bum's Rush action, for example), the atacked vampire
> have to tap? Or not? Please help!

No. Only two things (other than explicit instructions from card text) require
a minion to tap: taking an action and (successfully) blocking an action.

Messages.Author: mboh...@shout.net
Messages.Body:
In article <6tu6k5$6mb$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>,

rodrigo...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Hi! This question is disturbing the games I have been played. If I atack a
> untapped vampire (in a Bum's Rush action, for example), the atacked vampire
> have to tap? Or not? Please help!

Tapping only occurs in 3 ways -

1 - When announcing an action, you tap the acting minion.
2 - After you've successfully matched blocking conditions (like Stealth vs.
Intercept), the blocking minion is tapped.
3 - Explicit card text like Mind Numb and Faceless Night

Getting attacked while walking down the street a la Bum's Rush doesn't
tap the target minion.
